summary: V25 Nexus Avatar Collection full-stack pass. BACKEND (10/10 PASS via pytest test_nexus_avatars_v25.py): GET /api/nexus/avatars/collection returns all 6 avatars in ascending FP order (streetwear 1000 → void_wizard 100000), each with available=true, thumb, lod_urls (lod0/1/2), and all 7 animation_urls (idle/walk/run/jump/fall/land/greet); fire_balance=6500 as seeded. Unauthenticated 401. POST /api/nexus/avatars/av_streetwear/unlock burns exactly 1000 (balance 6500→5500) with ok+tx_id+burned=1000; repeat returns already_unlocked with no double-burn (balance stays 5500). POST /api/nexus/avatars/av_realm_guardian/unlock with 5500 balance returns 402 and balance unchanged. POST /api/nexus/avatars/av_unknown/unlock returns 404. POST /api/nexus/avatars/select with locked premium (av_realm_guardian) returns 403; select on unlocked av_streetwear returns ok and subsequent /collection shows equipped=true. Concurrency: 2 parallel unlock POSTs for av_tech_operative (5000) with balance 5500 → exactly ONE burn applied (final balance=500, exactly 1 doc in nexus_avatar_unlocks). GET /api/nexus/public 200 with zones; POST /api/nexus/join 200 (world v25 smoke OK). FRONTEND (all critical checks PASS via Playwright on preview URL, logged in as auditcheckreal): /nexus renders nexus-avatar-collection with 6 cards + thumbnail webp images loading from /nexus/av_*.webp, nexus-fp-balance shows 6,500, all 6 cost labels correct (1,000 → 100,000). avatar-thumb-av_aether_champion opens avatar-preview-dialog with avatar-preview-canvas and avatar-preview-unlock button; LOADING MODEL disappears in ~2s; avatar-preview-close removes the dialog. avatar-unlock-av_streetwear opens avatar-burn-dialog whose body contains 'cannot be reversed'; avatar-burn-cancel closes it; reopen + avatar-burn-confirm switches card to avatar-equip-av_streetwear (SELECT) and updates nexus-fp-balance to 5,500. Clicking avatar-equip-av_streetwear equips it (avatar-state-av_streetwear text = EQUIPPED). nexus-enter-btn → nexus-play-shell + nexus-hud mount (with nexus_bloom=off + nexus_gfx=low) within ~30s; nexus-hud-exit visible and returns to landing. Note: nexus-jump-btn / nexus-interact-btn / nexus-joystick-ring are mobile-only and not rendered at 1920x1080 desktop (expected).
critical_code_review_comments: routers/nexus.py avatar_unlock has a narrow but real concurrency hole: the insert into db.nexus_avatar_unlocks relies on a DuplicateKeyError to detect a race and refund, but there is NO unique index on (user_id, avatar_id) in the database (collection did not exist before this run, and no ensureIndex call was found for it in the backend). In the currently-tested scenario (balance exactly = cost) the atomic $gte wallet decrement acts as the mutex so only one path reaches insert; but if a user has ≥ 2*cost balance and fires two parallel requests, BOTH find_one_and_update succeed (each decrementing cost), and BOTH insert_one succeed → the user is charged 2x for a single avatar and gets a duplicate unlock doc. Fix: create a unique index on {user_id:1, avatar_id:1} for db.nexus_avatar_unlocks at startup, then the existing DuplicateKeyError refund branch will work.
routers/nexus.py is now 924 lines — well over the 700-line guideline. Split avatar-studio, magic, join/party, presence, admin into sub-routers.
AVATAR_FP_COSTS is a hard-coded Python dict inside nexus.py. Consider moving to a config collection or constants module so pricing can be updated without a deploy (and so tests can inject fixtures).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of applicable desktop checks (mobile-only HUD buttons correctly not rendered at 1920x1080)
